info.title: SupaOAuth Management API
info.description: SupaOAuth is a SupaCloud-hosted enterprise IAM and user-center control plane. In gotrue mode, GoTrue remains the OAuth/OIDC runtime and token issuer; SupaOAuth provides hosted UI, product RBAC, organizations, connectors, audit, configuration, and compatibility tooling.
